product.olivetti-echos-p120d.summary: The Echos P120D is documented in an 860T specimen.
product.olivetti-echos-p120d.history: Laptopi Muuseum holds a P120D dated 1996. Its inventory distinguishes it from the P100D 860C.
product.olivetti-echos-p120d.architectur: The type number identifies the specimen. The museum records 860T and a 120 MHz Pentium.
product.olivetti-echos-p120d.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-echos-p120d.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-echos-p120d.museum: Laptopi Muuseum, chronological inventory, entries 41 and 199.
